versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_susp_NtlmRelay.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - 'C:\windows\system32\davclnt.dll,DavSetCookie'
    - "http"
  CommandLine|contains:
    - "spoolss"
    - "srvsvc"
    - "/print/pipe/"
condition: selection
